verdict.rationale: The public pages disclose in advance that SOSPortal uses multi-factor authentication and that filing happens through an online portal. A Business Filings Guide and how-to videos are linked, but their contents are not evidenced. Nothing shows a published, explicit list of the account-creation, credential and identity-proofing steps a founder must clear before filing. missing for 10: explicit pre-flow enumeration of account registration requirements, any identity-proofing/verification steps, credential requirements beyond a bare MFA mention, and hands-on corroboration that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.
